basis: 71 physical pieces, 70 conservative parent-prefix groups; 68 nominally labeled pieces in 67 groups; 3 unknown rows unscored
data_access_before_plan: B03 inspected all 71 IDs and composition metadata for feasibility; no previously sealed final test exists
group_key: numeric prefix in sample_N-...; both sample_45 pieces remain together

outer_design.purpose: internal exploratory grouped out-of-fold prediction, not an independent confirmatory final test
outer_design.assignment_algorithm: sort all 70 distinct parent IDs by ascending SHA-256 hex digest of UTF-8 string TextileRoute:B04:v1:20260925:<group_id>; assign consecutive sorted groups round-robin to folds 0..4
outer_design.unknown_composition_groups: assigned to folds for bookkeeping but excluded from supervised fit and scored denominators

inner_design.purpose: choose only prespecified estimator hyperparameters and any future descriptive action margin within each outer-training partition
inner_design.assignment_algorithm: within the composition-labeled outer-training groups, sort by SHA-256 of UTF-8 string TextileRoute:B04:inner:v1:<outer_fold>:<group_id>; assign round-robin to inner folds 0..3
inner_design.metric: group-equal MAE on the primary supplier nominal cotton+wool+lyocell share
inner_design.tie_break: choose lower complexity: fewer PLS components or larger Ridge regularization; then lexical configuration ID
inner_design.no_outer_label_use: all fitting, learned scaling, model/hyperparameter/action-margin selection use only the outer-training groups

calibration.reason: too few independently labeled positive groups and no chemical reference or verified IID sampling; inner folds are selection, not a separate valid risk calibration set

final_evaluation.reason: all source composition metadata inspected in B03 and a small holdout would further deplete sparse groups; any pooled outer result is exploratory only
final_evaluation.future_confirmation: new independent audited data and newly frozen protocol required before confirmatory claims

preprocessing_boundary: fixed mathematical spectrum transforms may be applied per piece; any fitted centering, scaling, imputation, feature selection, dimensionality reduction, model parameters and thresholds remain inside each inner or outer training boundary
no_retuning: after any outer out-of-fold predictions are opened, changes to family, grid, target, split, metric, inclusion or advertised threshold are logged as exploratory and cannot replace the registered result
randomness: outer/inner assignment uses SHA-256 deterministic strings; any later stochastic learner/paired resampling uses seed 20260925, with library versions pinned at implementation time
no_execution: No split used for fitting or scoring in B04; this mapping is protocol metadata, not a performance test.
